m01:room.title: The Charge Mapping Annex
m01:room.job: Check the harbour relay's field sensor before the storm test.

m02:room.title: The Flux Survey Station
m02:room.job: Find out how much charge the storm's layer is holding over Port Mercy.

m03:room.title: The Atmospheric Potential Observatory
m03:room.job: Put bounds on the voltage between the storm layer and the ground.

m04:room.title: The Conductor Safety Garage
m04:room.job: Predict the field at the command van's mast tip.

m05:room.title: The Storm Capacitance Office
m05:room.job: Put a range on the capacitance between the storm layer and the ground.

m06:room.title: The Pulse Bank House
m06:room.job: Work out what the twelve-module bank stores and how fast it lets go.

m07:room.title: The Grounding and Metering Bay
m07:room.job: Find out whether the recorder's alarming reading came from the signal or from its own ground.

m08:room.title: The Magnetic Right-of-Way Depot
m08:room.job: Find the field the start cable puts on the control harness, and the push that comes with it.

m09:room.title: The Induction Survey Shed
m09:room.job: Work out how big a voltage the rising feeder current puts on the control loop beside it.

m10:room.title: The Feeder Dynamics Room
m10:room.job: Find how much voltage the feeder really needs while its current is ramping.

m11:room.title: The Conduit Current Audit
m11:room.job: Account for the current the feeder carries, and find the path nobody metered.

m12:room.title: The Radio Filter Test Bay
m12:room.job: Find how hard the surge filter's ringing pushed the radio control card.

m13:room.title: The Recorder Bandwidth Lab
m13:room.job: Find which recorder can follow the test pulse without shrinking it.

m14:room.title: The Full-System Induction Deck
m14:room.job: Predict each rack's loop voltage from one full-system pulse, then check it.

m15:room.title: The Control Experiment Workshop
m15:room.job: Test whether the smaller cable loop is what brought Rack E's voltage down.
